name: Code: Realize ~Shirogane no Kiseki~
source: Second fandisc in the Code: Realize series, containing after stories for the new routes from Shukufuku no Mirai. It also contains stories about the first Christmas Cardia spends with the bachelors, as well as a new story featuring the new character Cantarella.
translation: Code: Realize系列中的第二张同人光盘，包含《宿福未来》新路线的后续故事。它还包含有关卡迪亚与单身汉们度过的第一个圣诞节的故事，以及一个以新角色坎塔雷拉为主角的新故事。
